description: Feeds any three voltages into a Tricorder for graphing, and goes immediately to the left of it

params.text: Scales the three voltages passed on for graphing by a factor of 0 to 16, marked from minus infinity dB to +24dB, with 0dB leaving them unchanged
Attenuates and inverts the level CV
Adds a Tricorder to the right, which plots the vector this module sends it

inputs.text: The x voltage passed on for graphing; a polyphonic cable here is summed to a single voltage and added to the first channel of the P input
The y voltage passed on for graphing; a polyphonic cable here is summed to a single voltage and added to the second channel of the P input
The z voltage passed on for graphing; a polyphonic cable here is summed to a single voltage and added to the third channel of the P input
A trigger here clears the display of the connected Tricorder, which then starts plotting again from the next data it receives
A polyphonic input whose first three channels are added to the X, Y and Z inputs to make the vector passed on for graphing
Varies the scaling applied to the three voltages passed on for graphing

notes: this module has no output ports: place it immediately to the left of a Tricorder, and the voltages it reads are graphed there.
menu: Insert Tricorder on right — adds a Tricorder to the right, which plots the outgoing vector in 3D
Low sensitivity — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: divides that knob's effect by 10 and marks the knob with an orange dot
Unipolar mode — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: adds 5V to the CV on that control and clamps the result at zero

inputs.5:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
